'''Je'daii Master''' was a term which referred to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who had completed their studies within the [[Je'daii Order]] and were seen to have mastery over their skills in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Teachers and scholars, the Masters staffed the nine Great Temples of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in order to train the next generation.

==Overview==
A rank within the [[Je'daii Order]], Masters were members who had achieved such a comprehension of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as defined in the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] that the [[Je'daii Council]] saw fit to bestow upon them the rank of Master. Serving the Order by [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] on the Balance, Masters would teach at the Great Temples while others would go into seclusion and only appear to guide the rest of the Order in times of struggle or danger.<ref name="DOTJ0" />
